skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic and advanced concepts of descriptive and inferential statistics in economics, finance, and business.
Apply probability theory to analyze statistical data and support decision-making.
Use specialized software and programming languages to present data, perform calculations, and conduct statistical analysis.
Understand and apply Bayesian approaches in statistical analysis.
Independently learn and choose appropriate statistical methods for specific problems.
Interpret and analyze data using statistical methods.
Conduct hypothesis testing on parameters and non-parametric data.
Perform variance analysis on data sets.
Model and analyze data using statistical techniques.
Use programming languages like R for statistical analysis.
